# Error codes and events {#sec-codes}

A call reports failure through its status and its message, and everything else through events. This chapter lists the codes a call can return and describes each event biyos sends, field by field. The guide shows them at work in [Errors](#sec-errors) and [Events and timing](#sec-events).
